steps.title: Prepare 5‑Ad‑IAA stock solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve 5‑Ad‑IAA in DMSO to a final concentration of 5 mM, aliquot, and store at –30 °C.

steps.title: Grow starter culture in YPD
steps.instruction: Inoculate 5 mL YPD medium with the yeast strain and incubate overnight at 30 °C with shaking at 230 rpm.

steps.title: Dilute to mid‑log phase
steps.instruction: Dilute the overnight culture to OD₆₀₀ = 0.3 in 5 mL fresh YPD and grow at 30 °C, 230 rpm for 3–5 h until OD₆₀₀ ≈ 1.0.

steps.title: Harvest and wash cells for LiAc/PEG transformation
steps.instruction: Collect cells, wash, and resuspend in LiOAc buffer as described.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 1,000 × g for 5 min at ~25 °C; discard supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in 1 mL sterile water; transfer to a sterile 1.5 mL tube.
Centrifuge at 20,000 × g for 30 s at 25 °C; discard supernatant.
Resuspend pellet in 1 mL 0.1 M LiOAc.
Centrifuge again at 20,000 × g for 30 s, discard supernatant, and repeat centrifugation to ensure complete removal of liquid.

steps.title: Prepare DNA mixture for transformation
steps.instruction: Denature ssDNA, add plasmid and reagents, then incubate with PEG/LiOAc.

substeps.instruction: Heat 2.0 mg/mL ssDNA at 90 °C for ~5 min; cool on ice.
In the tube add: 2.0 mg/mL ssDNA, 25 µL pAlissAID plasmid, 1 µg sterile water, and bring volume to 50 µL.
Add 240 µL 50 % (w/v) PEG and 36 µL 1 M LiOAc.
Vortex briefly and incubate at 30 °C for 30 min.

steps.title: Heat‑shock transformation with DMSO
steps.instruction: Add DMSO, vortex, and perform a 42 °C heat shock.

substeps.instruction: Add 40 µL DMSO to the mixture and vortex.
Incubate in a heat block at 42 °C for 20 min.

steps.title: Recover cells and plate on selective medium
steps.instruction: Centrifuge, resuspend, and plate on appropriate SD dropout agar.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 20,000 × g for 30 s at room temperature; discard supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in the remaining supernatant (minimum 50 µL).
Spread the suspension onto an SD plate lacking the appropriate marker (His, Leu, Trp, or Ura) matching the pAlissAID plasmid’s selection marker.
Incubate plates at 30 °C for 2–3 days.

steps.title: Select transformants and confirm plasmid integration
steps.instruction: Pick colonies that grew on selective plates, culture them in SD medium, and verify plasmid presence by immunoblot, fluorescence microscopy, phenotyping, or another suitable method.

steps.title: Add 5‑Ad‑IAA to liquid medium
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL of the 5 mM 5‑Ad‑IAA stock per 1 mL of SD medium (final 5 µM) and mix.

steps.title: Prepare 5‑Ad‑IAA‑containing agar plates
steps.instruction: Cool autoclaved SD agar to ~50 °C, add 5‑Ad‑IAA to a final concentration of 5 µM, pour plates, and store at 4 °C protected from light for up to one month.

steps.title: Assay protein degradation by fluorescence microscopy
steps.instruction: Grow cells in SD medium, treat with 5‑Ad‑IAA, and observe fluorescence.

substeps.instruction: Day 1: Inoculate 5 mL SD medium and grow overnight at 30 °C, 230 rpm.
Day 2: Dilute culture to OD₆₀₀ = 0.3 in 5 mL SD medium; grow at 30 °C, 230 rpm for 3–5 h until OD₆₀₀ ≈ 1.0.
Add 5 µL of 5 mM 5‑Ad‑IAA (final 5 µM) and incubate at 30 °C, 230 rpm for 1–3 h.
Collect cells, optionally fix with 4 % paraformaldehyde, and examine live (or fixed) cells under a fluorescence microscope.
Optional: Perform a 10‑fold serial dilution spotting assay on SD plates with or without 5 µM 5‑Ad‑IAA to assess growth of essential‑protein strains.

description: Validation of protocol This protocol or parts of it has been used and validated in the following research article: Ogawa et al. (2023). Development of AlissAID system targeting GFP or mCherry fusion protein. PLOS Genetics (Figure 5).
